reviews_captured_by_me.text:
William Olsen made a beautiful dining table for me with Chinese Elm and English Walnut. I just LOVE it! The wood is stunning. He also made the cherry blossom triptych art on the wall behind the table. Just beautiful.

William Olsen is a stand up businessman and craftsman with integrity and a great sense of humor. His prices may be a bit more than the average furniture/cabinet maker, but what you get is FINE custom
One-of-a-kind work! I can't recommend enough.

It is difficult to express in words the absolute artistry William Olsen brings to his pieces.  He has completed 4 large built-ins for our home and each one is a statement of the utmost in professional design, creativity and functionality. Visitors to our home admire his pieces every time.  William is a joy to work with, too.  We would have no one else do any custom wood work in our home.

William Olsen Designs helped me design and build simple/multifaceted birch side panels for my Sprinter van in 2013. Seven years later, my panels are still serving me beautifully! William is a skilled woodworker through and through and I will gladly use his services again in the future. It’s also worth noting that William Olsen Designs is equipped with all the latest, top-notch tools and equipment. This is not another hipster garage shop, but an incredibly professional, custom woodworking outfit.
